test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a government initiated insurance scheme, administered by LIC, for rural landless households?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana **covers natural death/accidental death, permanent total disability, and partial permanent disability**.
 
• The scheme **gives coverage to individuals** residing in **rural areas and individuals who are below the poverty line.**
 
• “Aam Admi Bima Yojana” has come into effect from **01.01.** **2013**.
 
• One member of the family who is the** householder is eligible for coverage.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30a8c82155d993b5c415c11ab1e2d5835f7b37af3672eeb0196cc744c2afc08a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Janashree Bima Yojana **is a government life insurance scheme that was **started together with the LIC. **
 
• **Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana** has been started by Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India to **provide health insurance coverage for Below Poverty Line (BPL) families**. **​**
 
• **LIC's Jeevan Umang plan** offers a combination of income and protection to your family.
